title: Spending Northgate Cash and Expiry of Earnings
content:
**Redemption.** Northgate Cash earned under Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships may be applied to a Northgate order in the tier's redemption channels, in any amount from the tier's smallest redemption amount up to the current Northgate Cash balance, and never to the purchase types the tier excludes from redemption. Northgate Cash cannot be redeemed while the balance is zero or negative, and cannot be exchanged for cash. A redemption consumes the oldest unexpired earnings first.

**Expiry.** Each earning expires the tier's expiry months in calendar months after its earn date, on the same calendar day or the last day of a shorter month; the amount expired is the part of that earning not consumed by redemptions or reversals under that oldest-first order.

**Closing the membership.** Closing the membership does not forfeit Northgate Cash: the balance stays redeemable until each earning expires. This follows the tier setting on forfeiture at cancellation, which is "not forfeited" on every tier.

**Worked illustration (hypothetical earnings, 12-month expiry)**

| Earning | Earn date | Amount | Consumed by a 6.00 redemption on 10 March 2031 | Expiry date | Amount expired |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| first | 1 February 2031 | 5.00 | 5.00 | 1 February 2032 | 0.00 |
| second | 1 March 2031 | 3.00 | 1.00 | 1 March 2032 | 2.00 |

The redemption takes the older earning in full before drawing on the newer one, and each earning expires only in the part not yet consumed.

**Expiry date at month end (hypothetical).** An earning dated 31 May 2031 with a 9-month expiry would fall on 29 February 2032, the last day of that shorter month; with the 12-month expiry it falls on 31 May 2032.

**Basis Q&A**

*The balance shows a negative figure after a return; can the member apply Cash to today's order?* No. Northgate Cash cannot be redeemed while the balance is zero or negative.
